searchText: I am not worthy to make threads 😅 > history expiry - No updates on rollout, testing, or documentation. Would you like one, from an operator? Mainnet tests below: Users need to seek this behavior. The flags exist, expiry is not yet default. - Nethermind: In a release, works well on mainnet. - Geth: I've seen failures on Sepolia with `1.15.11`, resolved in `master` - Besu: In `25.6.0-RC1`, works well on mainnet. - Erigon: There’s a PR, I was able to sync mainnet with history expiry. - Reth: An issue is open for pre-merge expiry. They’ll need the blocks to execute them (full sync) and might use era1 for that, before dropping the blocks. - Nimbus EL: pre-alpha, but in my testing works on mainnet. Requires era1 import from which only headers are taken. Full sync only. I have not tested eth/69. I know Besu has it behind an -X flag, unsure about Geth, and even more unsure about the others. We have about two, max three months before our Besu and Reth nodes run out of space. By then either there’s a history expiry option (even if we need to seek it), or we need to switch to a client with expiry. We are seeing an increasing number of solo stakers with space anxiety in ethstaker and RocketPool Discords. Happily a large portion of those run Geth or Nethermind and so can expire pre-merge history now. Nimbus EL have eth/69 implemented https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth1/pull/3283 Thanks Yorick. Besu is planning a prerelease for sepolia tomorrow + docs. Mainnet-ready release will follow once we are happy with testing on sepolia. I’d expect documentation about history expiry from the client teams to be honest, not from an operator. We need detailed documentation about client specific flags and how they meant to be used. Coming no doubt. ACDC #158 in 59 mins! X: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1eaKbWpkYQnGX Not sure if this is the best place to ask, but we are in the middle of trying to run a large fleet of Hoodi validators and are in need of a large chunk of Hoodi ETH to do so. Could someone point me in the right direction to accumulate substantial Hoodi Eth? Maybe <@1348937577679556688> feel like I have seen you being able to provide. Try <https://github.com/ethpandaops/fundingvault>

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content:
I am not worthy to make threads 😅 

> history expiry - No updates on rollout, testing, or documentation.

Would you like one, from an operator?

Mainnet tests below: Users need to seek this behavior. The flags exist, expiry is not yet default.

- Nethermind: In a release, works well on mainnet.
- Geth: I've seen failures on Sepolia with `1.15.11`, resolved in `master`
- Besu: In `25.6.0-RC1`, works well on mainnet.
- Erigon: There’s a PR, I was able to sync mainnet with history expiry.
- Reth: An issue is open for pre-merge expiry. They’ll need the blocks to execute them (full sync) and might use era1 for that, before dropping the blocks.
- Nimbus EL: pre-alpha, but in my testing works on mainnet. Requires era1 import from which only headers are taken. Full sync only.

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: I have not tested eth/69. I know Besu has it behind an -X flag, unsure about Geth, and even more unsure about the others.

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content:
We have about two, max three months before our Besu and Reth nodes run out of space. By then either there’s a history expiry option (even if we need to seek it), or we need to switch to a client with expiry.
We are seeing an increasing number of solo stakers with space anxiety in ethstaker and RocketPool Discords. Happily a large portion of those run Geth or Nethermind and so can expire pre-merge history now.
